4.name: New Days
4.overview: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

4.name: The Dungeon Evolves
4.overview: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

4.name: The Avatar Team Is Formed
4.overview: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

4.name: Invitation
4.overview: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

4.name: The First Step
4.overview: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

4.name: The Council of the West
4.overview: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

4.name: The Mastermind's Identity
4.overview: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

4.name: The Groundwork of Greed
4.overview: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

4.name: Investigating the Ruins
4.overview: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

4.name: The Master of Greed
4.overview: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

4.name: Milim's Friend
4.overview: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

4.name: Tempest Evolves
4.overview: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

4.name: New Companions
4.overview: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

4.name: The Black Numbers
4.overview: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

4.name: An Unsettling Feeling
4.overview: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

4.name: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
4.overview: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

4.name: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
4.overview: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

4.name: Turbulence in the West
4.overview: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

4.name: Death and Loss
4.overview: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

4.name: Chronoa the Hero (1)
4.overview: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

4.name: Chronoa the Hero (2)
4.overview: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

4.name: Where the Soul Resides
4.overview: Chronoa is freed from her seal—not as a Hero, but as an avatar of destruction.

4.name: Granville's Hope
4.overview: Shion and Ranga continue to battle Razul while Rimuru struggles to save Chloe and Hinata.

4.name: The Hero Awakens
4.overview: Rimuru has Raphael interfere in Chronoa's Unlimited Imprisonment skill to save Hinata and Chloe.

lastEpisodeToAir.name: The Hero Awakens
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: Rimuru has Raphael interfere in Chronoa's Unlimited Imprisonment skill to save Hinata and Chloe.

originalTitle: 転生したらスライムだった件
overview: میکامی ساتورو، کارمند ۳۷ ساله شرکت توسط یک قاتل تصادفی مورد حمله قرار می‌گیرد و دوباره در دنیایی دیگر متولد می‌شود. اما در می‌یابد که به‌عنوان یک اسلایم حیات دوباره یافته است! او که با نام ریمورو تِمپِست به این دنیای جدید پرتاب شده است، تلاش خود را برای ایجاد دنیایی آغاز می‌کند که پذیرای همه نژادها باشد. رها از زندگی معمولی و قدیمی گذشته، ماجراجویی تازه او در یک دنیای خیالی به‌عنوان یک هیولای اسلایمی با توانایی‌های منحصر به‌فرد آغاز می‌شود.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Now that the Jura Tempest Alliance is growing even further, they will now be meeting the animal kingdom of Eurazania, reuniting with King Gazel, rising tensions between monsters and humans, and Rimuru encountering the strongest enemy he’s ever faced.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: After Clayman’s defeat, Rimuru returns home and learns that Diablo healed the nobles of Falmuth, securing their alliance with Tempest. Meanwhile, Hinata becomes suspicious of Rimuru’s growing power and confronts him—unaware that a powerful organization is pulling the strings behind the scenes.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect mankind by ruling over them. Meanwhile, in El Dorado, Demon Lord Leon works toward goals of his own. The awakening of a new Hero draws near!

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
